data.text: Luke, I’d rather catch 10 tons each this month and make that our standing agreement. That earns each of us $10,000 monthly while letting the lake replenish to 100 tons—without sacrificing next month’s income for a temporary increase now. I commit to 10 this month and propose that we review the revealed catches together before setting next month’s limits. John, will you join me in supporting 10 each?
